# DEVPACK

> > DEVPACK provides packaging design, optimization, and compliance consulting services with expertise in EU regulations (PPWR, AGEC law), sustainable materials (HDPE, PP, PET), and circular economy solutions.

DEVPACK specializes in helping businesses navigate complex packaging challenges including regulatory compliance, material selection, testing and validation, and sustainable design. The company offers technical analysis, CSR-focused solutions, and expertise in e-commerce, food contact, and palletization packaging across European markets.

## Key Topics

- PPWR (Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation)
- AGEC law
- Circular economy (Recycle, Reduce, Reuse)
- Sustainable packaging design
- HDPE (high-density polyethylene)
- Polypropylene (PP)
- PET materials
- Regulatory compliance
- LCA (Life Cycle Analysis)
- Food contact materials (EC 1935/2004)
- CSRD reporting
- Eco-design principles
- Waste reduction strategies
- Product protection and cushioning
- Traceability and quality controls

## Core Services

- [Packaging designing and optimization expertise](https://www.devpack.eu): Homepage: DEVPACK packaging optimization and design consulting services
- [Packaging- Product Performance Analysis](https://www.devpack.eu/analysis): LCA and packaging performance analysis services
- [Follow-up and Validation of the Approval Plan and Packaging Tests](https://www.devpack.eu/qualification): Packaging testing, validation, and compliance certification services
- [Inform & Communicate: DevPack](https://www.devpack.eu/inform-communicate): Packaging labeling, consumer communication, and marketing compliance

## Regulatory Compliance & Standards

- [Packaging Compliance: Identify Essential Regulations](https://www.devpack.eu/packaging-efficiency/regulatory-and-legislative-requirements/identify-packaging-regulations-based): EU PPWR and international packaging regulations compliance guide
- [Packaging: Combine Optimization and Regulatory Compliance](https://www.devpack.eu/packaging-efficiency/regulatory-and-legislative-requirements/optimizing-packaging-while-complying): Balance packaging optimization with AGEC law and regulatory compliance
- [Guarantee Non-Toxicity for Packaging Materials](https://www.devpack.eu/packaging-efficiency/regulatory-and-legislative-requirements/ensuring-packaging-material-compliance): Non-toxic food contact materials compliance per EC Regulation 1935/2004
- [Ensure Compliance with Rigorous Quality Controls](https://www.devpack.eu/packaging-efficiency/regulatory-and-legislative-requirements/strict-quality-controls-key-challenge): Quality controls and compliance for food packaging and traceability

## Sustainable & Circular Packaging Solutions

- [The 3 Rs: Recycle, Reduce, Reuse](https://www.devpack.eu/3-r-recycle-reduce-reuse): Circular economy framework per AGEC law and Directive 94/62/EC
- [Low-Carbon Materials: Eco-Friendly Packaging Solutions](https://www.devpack.eu/packaging-efficiency/csr-challenges/use-low-carbon-footprint-materials-packaging): Low-carbon materials and eco-friendly packaging for carbon footprint reduction
- [Closed-Loop Recycling: Sustainable Packaging](https://www.devpack.eu/packaging-efficiency/csr-challenges/closed-loop-recycling-designing-sustainable-and-high-quality): Closed-loop recycling and CSR-focused sustainable packaging design
- [Strategies to Reduce Palletization Waste](https://www.devpack.eu/strategies-reduce-and-recycle-palletization-waste): Waste reduction strategies for palletization using HDPE and PP materials
- [Palletization: Reusable vs Single-use Comparison](https://www.devpack.eu/palletization-reusable-solutions-vs-single-use): Compare reusable vs single-use palletization under PPWR and CRDS

## Industry-Specific Solutions

- [E-commerce & Postal & Parcel Packaging Solutions](https://www.devpack.eu/parcel-packaging-e-commerce-postal-and-courier-services): E-commerce and courier packaging solutions with sustainable materials
